4.11
Vector Database Design
Semantic document retrieval requires efficient storage of embedding vectors.
The system uses FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) for this purpose.
Each workspace maintains an independent vector index.
Each vector entry contains:
• Chunk ID
• Document ID
• Page Number
• Chunk Index
• Chunk Text
• 384-Dimensional Embedding Vector
Workspace isolation prevents vectors from different projects from mixing.
